# Integrate Eka EMR

The calls themselves: where they live, what they need in their headers, every operation, and one request written out in full.

## Hosts

- `https://api.eka.care` Production
- `https://api.dev.eka.care` Stage/Sandbox
- `https://{partner_host}`

## Auth and headers

Get a token first: [Authentication](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/auth/getting-started).

- `bearerAuth`: HTTP bearer. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- `auth`: API key in the `auth` header.

Headers that some operations require:

- `Authorization`
- `auth`
- `client-id`

## One request in full

POST /cdr/v1/doctor/, from [its page](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/emr/onboarding-apis/onboard-doctor).

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.eka.care/cdr/v1/doctor/' \
  -H 'auth: <auth>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "firstname": "Rajesh",
  "lastname": "Sharma",
  "mobile": "0000011111",
  "dob": "1999-01-01",
  "email": "dr.rajesh@example.com",
  "gender": "M",
  "specialisations": [
    "Cardiology",
    "Internal Medicine"
  ],
  "qualifications": [
    "MBBS",
    "MD",
    "DM"
  ],
  "about": "Dr. Rajesh Sharma is a renowned cardiologist with over 15 years of experience in interventional cardiology.",
  "profile_image_url": "https://example.com/images/dr-rajesh.jpg",
  "clinic_ids": [
    "c-ab2c-34f2d-2gwd-2g2g"
  ],
  "partner_clinic_ids": [
    "Part_clinic_1"
  ],
  "partner_id": "Part_doc"
}'
```
